remarks: NEW TO THE MARKET! WELCOME TO THIS COMPLETELY RENOVATED ONE-BEDROOM END UNIT TOWNHOUSE WITH AN EXTENDED LOFT AND A VIEW OF THE SLOPES AT HOLIDAY VALLEY! THE VILLAGE OF ELLICOTTVILLE IS ALSO JUST A SHORT DISTANCE AWAY, OFFERING A WONDERFUL SELECTION OF RESTAURANTS, SHOPS, ENTERTAINMENT AND YEAR-ROUND EVENTS. WHETHER YOU ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSONAL SKI GETAWAY, A FOUR-SEASON VACATION HOME OR AN INVESTMENT PROPERTY, THIS TOWNHOUSE OFFERS THE LOCATION AND AMENITIES TO MAKE THE MOST OF THE ELLICOTTVILLE LIFESTYLE. LOCATED IN A POPULAR AND AFFORDABLE TOWNHOUSE DEVELOPMENT, THIS UNIT ALSO COMES WITH A GREAT RENTAL HISTORY, MAKING IT AN ATTRACTIVE OPPORTUNITY FOR BOTH PERSONAL USE AND INCOME POTENTIAL. COME ENJOY THE SLOPES, GOLF, VILLAGE AND EVERYTHING HOLIDAY VALLEY AND ELLICOTTVILLE HAVE TO OFFER—ALL FROM YOUR OWN RETREAT! SHORT-TERM RENTALS ALLOWED WITH AN APPROVED PERMIT.
